text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Let's get steppin', you two!
We're off to that Uma Lord's
castle!
text_block_list.name: Mercenary Machos

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but where is it? How're we gonna
get there if we don't know
the way?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Well, let me provide you with a
vague and mysterious clue.
text_block_list.name: Mystic Granny

text_block_list.text:
No! Gimme a straight answer! I've had
enough of the riddles!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I know something that may come in handy.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Umamusume Skill—Pace Up!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
A summary is in store! Somehow or
another, our party of heroes
manage to
pinpoint the location of the Uma Lord's
castle.
text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава

text_block_list.text:
They advance! And they arrive! There at
the castle, they will finally
face off against
the menacing Uma Lord! Summary finished!
text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that Pace Up skill was super
effective!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Huhhh?! You're here already? I didn't even
have time to put on my
cape!
text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi

text_block_list.text:
What happened to that Super Golshi Ogre
EX that I cunningly
positioned in your
path?!
text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi

text_block_list.text: Didn't see it. We took a shortcut.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
You must have had your fill of fun by now,
Golshi. It's time to stop the
games.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
With this bolt of lightning, you will be sent
back to our home world!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Huh, what's that crazy holy aura? Did you
evolve into an Uma Angel
or something?!
text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi

text_block_list.text:
Divine judgment, come down and cleanse
this world! Angelic Bolt!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Ooohhh! There it is, the ultimate spell to
conquer the Uma Lord! Time
for the
credits to roll!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah? So much for bein' a cleric! A
little tickle like that couldn't
fix a cramp,
let alone the game!
text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi

text_block_list.text: What the?! It had no effect?!
text_block_list.name: Mercenary Machos

text_block_list.text: I knew it...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Grass! Qué pasó? Why didn't your spell
work? Was the legend
wrong?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I had a feeling this might happen.
Something about the phrasing has
been
eating at me.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
"With innate, thunderous power, she will
deliver unto the demon lord
a strike of
destruction and felicity alike." It calls the
power "innate",
right? And it supposedly
brings both destruction and felicity.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Magic power isn't something innate to
Umamusume. If we were meant
to defeat
the Uma Lord, perhaps it wouldn't be
through a spell.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I'm not followin' you too well, but... what's
clear is defeatin' her won't
be as simple as
we thought.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
In which case, let's give this fantasy story a
classic fantasy endin'!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Oh? What kind? A battle between our pet
summons? A cook-off with
the random
ingredients clogging our inventories?
text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi

text_block_list.text:
Nah, it's not a real RPG without some
fist-on-fist action! Bring it on,
Uma Lord!
Try wrestling your way through a
sixty-minute singles
match with yours truly!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Oh! So that's how it is? Two can play at
that game! Forget
wrestling—it's not a
JRPG without a collectible card minigame!
text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi

text_block_list.text: Take thaaaat!
text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi

text_block_list.text:
Aaagh, I'm done for! That limited edition
Mil Masterio slammer got
me good!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Another win for Team Golshi! I knew my
first edition Umandam cards
wouldn't let
me down! People slept on them after the
show was
canceled, but they're super
strong!
text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi

text_block_list.text:
El! Are you really going to waste our time
playing that silly game?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: I mean, I had to give it a go! It looked so much fun...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Well, if cards aren't cutting it for you, let's
settle this like true
Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi

text_block_list.text:
What better contest is there than a race?
With my Uma Lord powers,
conjuring up a
course will be an easy-peasy piece of
cupcake!
text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi

text_block_list.text:
Welcome to Toky—I mean... Demonkyo
Racecourse!
text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi

text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! Just like that and we're practically
at the real Tokyo
Racecourse!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
All right, El, Grass! Bet you can't complain
if we settle this fair and
mostly square on
the fantasy track!
text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi

text_block_list.text: Just wait until you see my demon dash!
text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi

text_block_list.text: Oooh, now that's what I'm talkin' about! Brawler's physically the strongest class in Uma Quest. I can't lose!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Oh, all right. But please, El, don't let your
guard down.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Qué? What's wrong, Grass? The look on
your face is freakin' me out.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: You heard what Golshi said just now. She's going to fight "fair and mostly square".
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
This isn't the real Tokyo. We're still in
Umanest, a virtual kingdom of
swords and
spells.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
We're about to run in a fantasy
race—where blades will clash and
spells
will soar!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
